## IntegerHelpers interface

Validation and explicit conversion into [Integer](./contracts.integer.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IntegerHelpers
```

## Remarks

Each helper either returns a valid integer or throws. None of them clamps: a value outside [INTEGER_LIMITS](./contracts.integer_limits.md) is always rejected, even after rounding or truncation.

[is(value)](./contracts.integerhelpers.is.md)

</td><td>

Whether `value` is an integer: a finite, integral number within [INTEGER_LIMITS](./contracts.integer_limits.md)<!-- -->. `-0` qualifies.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[round(value)](./contracts.integerhelpers.round.md)

</td><td>

Round `value` to the nearest integer, with halves rounded away from zero (`2.5` → `3`<!-- -->, `-2.5` → `-3`<!-- -->), then validate it.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[truncate(value)](./contracts.integerhelpers.truncate.md)

</td><td>

Drop the fractional part of `value` (round toward zero: `2.9` → `2`<!-- -->, `-2.9` → `-2`<!-- -->), then validate it. The result is never `-0`<!-- -->.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[validate(value)](./contracts.integerhelpers.validate.md)

</td><td>

Return `value` as an [Integer](./contracts.integer.md)<!-- -->, or throw if it is not one.

</td></tr>
